resources.name: NHS 111
resources.what: Urgent but non-emergency medical help, including mental health. 24 hours.

resources.name: Samaritans
resources.what: Free, 24-hour listening line. You do not have to be in crisis to call.

resources.name: Shout
resources.what: Free 24/7 text support if you would rather not speak to anyone.

resources.name: Your GP
resources.what: For functioning that has dropped and stayed dropped. This is the one people skip.

resources.name: Acas
resources.what: Free, impartial advice on workplace rights, including reasonable adjustments.

emergency.what: If you or someone else is in immediate danger.
